The '''Attack on the ''Jynni's Virtue''''' was an event that occurred in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], exactly six [[Standard month/Legends|months]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Starship/Legends|vessel]], ''Jynni's Virtue'', commanded by [[Naz Felyood]] was attacked by [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaked]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] patrol ships over Korriban resulting in the ''Jynni's Virtue'' being stranded on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]].
